newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady, UK petrol tax as expecte.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady, UK petrol tax as expecte.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended steady on Tuesday with demand looking lacklustre but traders reluctant to set new positions before inventory data out later today and Wednesday's OPEC meeting.
The U.S. Thanksgiving day holiday on Thursday and end-of-the-month balancing also limited activity.
"I kind of expected the market to come off more, but it has held," said one barge trader.
"We're just waiting for more confirmation on the Iraqi stories and the Thanksgiving holiday is coming up," he said.
Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke on Tuesday announced a three pence per litre tax increase on all petrol and diesel fuels, effective at 1800 GMT.
Traders said the tax increase was as expected, but European prices may still weaken in coming weeks because the tanks are full in the U.K. and exports may rise.
Prices have already reflected some of that negative attitude, with barges trading near Dec swaps.
Eurograde barges ended unchanged at $207/$209 fob ARA with regular unleaded also steady at $200/$202.
